description: This source file defines a custom Android layout class 'ShadowLayout' that extends RelativeLayout. It is designed to draw a drop shadow behind its child views, with shadow properties such as depth and opacity that can be animated.

classes.name: ShadowLayout
classes.description: A custom RelativeLayout that renders a shadow behind its child views, with configurable depth and opacity.

methods.name: setShadowDepth
methods.description: Sets the depth of the shadow, affecting its offset and transparency.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the default drawing method to render shadows behind each child view.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes drawing parameters and pre-renders the shadow bitmap.
